Remark
[splitting via a Hessian-flat submersion to $\mathbb R^k$]

Source: petersen:page-0238 ↗ def:pet-ch5-geodesically-complete 1. ch5:5.9.12If $F:(M,g)\to (\mathbb R^k,g_{\mathbb R^k})$ is a Riemannian submersion, $(M,g)$ complete, and each component of $F$ has zero Hessian, show $(M,g)=(N,h)\times (\mathbb R^k,g_{\mathbb R^k})$.
